# The Good Human

> goodhuman.in is the landing page of The Good Human, a portal about good human beings: people who are kind, empathetic, honest, compassionate and humble.

## Who is a good human?

A good human being possesses qualities such as kindness, empathy, integrity, compassion, and humility. They treat others with respect, show understanding and support, and act selflessly for the well-being of others. They are honest, trustworthy, and stand up for what is right.

> "Be a good human being, a warmhearted, affectionate person. That is my fundamental belief." (Dalai Lama)
